where_to_look: BCRA monthly bank-level data and the CNV/BYMA filing of the quarterly financial statements (Spanish, often filed locally before or alongside the ADR release). Check whether the local filing is already public.

Peers that have already printed 3Q26: BBVA Argentina's 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000913059/000129281426005393/bbarpr3q26_6k.htm), Galicia/GGAL and Supervielle/SUPV. Look at asset quality, NPL build and real-terms loan growth as read-through.

Inflation-adjusted (IAS 29) result versus the nominal headline. The key lines are monetary-position loss, government-securities mark-to-market after the October-November Argentine sell-off, and the loan-loss provision build.
Dividend/capital distribution policy: excess capital is large (CAR about 30% in 3Q25), so check any BCRA authorisation on dividend payouts.
